candidates.change_summary: Remove the check against the IERC1155 interface id so that calls with that id no longer return true.
Remove the check against the IERC1155MetadataURI interface id so that calls with that id no longer return true.
Remove the fallback super.supportsInterface call so the IERC165 (ERC-165) interface id no longer returns true.
Return the balance of the zero address instead of the queried account.
Return the balance of token id 0 instead of the queried token id.
Swap the mapping indices so the account and token id are transposed in the balance lookup.
Always return a constant 0 instead of the stored balance.
